task.title: Finally verify fresh self-authorization and forgotten-password isolation
task.input: reauth-dialog, single-purpose ActionGrant, security mutations and the limited-recovery entry
task.output: fresh-auth-acceptance: fresh authorization/concurrent consumption/missing-current-password negative evidence
task.accept: 1) Trigger real POST /api/admin/account/reauth from profile actions. Only current password plus an unused TOTP yields a five-minute grant. Concurrent use of one TOTP step yields at most one grant, and concurrent use of one grant yields at most one mutation. Wrong purpose/target/device, expired or revoked grants are denied with unchanged state (E-72, E-73, E-74). 2) Through real enrollment/mode-switch entries, submit wrong, expired and replayed codes and two concurrent switches. The final transaction rechecks pending state/deadline/sv; errors cannot commit and at most one concurrent switch succeeds. At least one verified login method remains after failure (E-08). 3) A passwordless-enabled user who forgot the current password can still log in with email+totp for nonsensitive work. A session alone or TOTP alone cannot obtain a normal grant through reauth or directly mutate sensitive settings. The UI points to independent limited recovery; that path only permits new-factor binding with audit, and HTTP cannot write pendingPasswordHash (E-75).
